get.description: List active official model endpoints and multi-vendor relay stations from the database. The response contains public routing metadata only and never exposes API keys.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on channel code, name, description, base URL, vendor, and model.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by official endpoint or relay station.

parameters.name: vendor_code
parameters.description: Filter channels that expose at least one model from this vendor.

parameters.name: agent_provider_id
parameters.description: Filter channels compatible with an Agent Config SPI provider.

put.description: Create or update tenant-owned public metadata for an official endpoint or multi-vendor relay station. API keys are forbidden and must be configured through sdkwork-agents Config SPI.

parameters.name: channelCode
parameters.description: Stable tenant-owned model access channel code.

requestBody.description: Public model access channel metadata without credentials.
